tldr: Google's new Gemini tool retrieval and Genie 4 API make large agent toolkits and interactive multimodal environments more accessible, while desktop automation and European-model deployments broaden practical AI workflows.

OpenEval's expanded item-level data and research on speculative decoding, coding-agent environments and distillation offer promising efficiency and evaluation ideas, but their measurements are largely maintainer- or author-reported; chip-export disclosures concern approvals rather than proven deliveries.

news.title: Google previews on-demand tool-schema retrieval in Gemini API
news.summary: Google added Tool Retrieval preview to the Interactions API: developers can defer function schemas and have the system load them when selected by tool search.
news.why_it_matters: Large tool inventories may avoid repeated schema tokens and preserve prompt-cache prefixes.
news.caveat: Models still see tool descriptions; authorization remains the developer's responsibility. Token and latency gains are conditional and calls are billed normally.

news.title: Genie 4 interactive world generation reaches Gemini API
news.summary: Google opened Genie 4 developer access through Gemini Interactions API and AI Studio, describing interactive 720p, 24-fps visual worlds with native audio and live controls.
news.why_it_matters: Interactive simulation could support prototyping, game design and synthetic robot-agent environments.
news.caveat: World consistency, physical fidelity, latency, access and cost are not independently tested; SynthID watermarking is announced.

news.title: Gemini for Mac introduces isolated desktop computer-use agent
news.summary: Google began a U.S. English rollout of computer-use workflows in a separate Mac window with app permissions, action previews and user approvals.
news.why_it_matters: Moves application and file automation beyond browser-only agents while preserving user interaction with the main desktop.
news.caveat: Requires Apple Silicon, macOS 15+, eligible adult personal account and paid AI plan; computer-use mistakes and data exposure remain risks.

news.title: Google targets 2029 orbital AI infrastructure launch with Blue Origin
news.summary: Google announced a Blue Origin New Glenn partnership targeting Q1 2029 to launch rack-scale compute satellites for Project Suncatcher.
news.why_it_matters: Tests an unconventional long-horizon response to AI energy and facility constraints.
news.caveat: This is a plan, not a deployed AI data center; economics, radiation tolerance, thermal design, networking and mission success are unproven.

news.title: NVIDIA and Microsoft expand cloud-to-PC AI deployment stack
news.summary: NVIDIA described expanded Azure Vera Rubin NVL72 VM access, model customization through Microsoft Foundry, and enterprise edge/Windows deployment options.
news.why_it_matters: Provides additional GPU and software pathways for training, customizing and serving models across cloud and local environments.
news.caveat: Availability varies by product and region; this announcement does not establish independent benchmarks or universal customer access.

news.title: Google plans wider vulnerability-report publication amid AI-assisted submissions
news.summary: Google updated its vulnerability reward program disclosure policy for qualifying reports filed from December 1, citing higher volumes of AI-generated and duplicate findings.
news.why_it_matters: More transparent, repaired vulnerability disclosures can improve the training signal for defenders and security researchers.
news.caveat: This is a policy change, not a new attack incident; publication is restricted by rewards, remediation and privacy conditions.

news.title: OpenEval adds item-level data from hundreds of models
news.summary: The Open Eval Commons dataset card records expansion to 41 benchmarks, about 4.74M items and 23.12M responses from 567 models.
news.why_it_matters: Response-level data can support reanalysis of rankings, error modes and model agreement instead of aggregate-only claims.
news.caveat: Counts are maintainer-reported, benchmarks overlap, and dataset is CC BY-NC 4.0; large downloads and redistribution rights need review.

news.title: Qwant and OVHcloud detail EU-hosted search and model partnership
news.summary: OVHcloud, Qwant, Shadow and EUSP announced a European-hosted search-answer stack using Olala mini, Shadow GPUs and an independent web index.
news.why_it_matters: A deployment example connecting European model training, search provenance and hosting rather than a model announcement alone.
news.caveat: Three-million-query daily volume and speed/resource comparisons are company claims; data-residency and sovereignty compliance were not independently audited.

news.title: OVHcloud debuts sparse 7B-parameter Olala mini model at AI summit
news.summary: Announced November 17 for a November 19 summit launch, Olala mini 7A1B combines 7B total and about 1B active parameters with a hybrid Differential-TPA/Mamba-3 design.
news.why_it_matters: Adds a compact European-trained language-model alternative for constrained inference and search summarization.
news.caveat: Publisher's 8GB GPU and CPU token speeds are configuration-dependent; independently verified model artifacts, license and pricing require checking.

news.title: Reuters reports House disclosure of 879,000 AI-chip export approvals
news.summary: Reuters reported that a U.S. House committee released figures for 879,000 Nvidia and AMD AI-chip export approvals to Chinese buyers during December 2025–May 2026.
news.why_it_matters: Shows policy-defined potential compute supply in a politically sensitive AI hardware market.
news.caveat: Approvals are not verified deliveries; company military-link descriptions are allegations, not proven violations. The reported approvals concern older months.

news.title: NVIDIA showcases agent-built Omniverse simulations
news.summary: NVIDIA published developer examples combining frontier coding agents with Omniverse physics, rendering and sensor-simulation libraries.
news.why_it_matters: Illustrates a human-supervised workflow for constructing and iterating virtual environments used in robot development.
news.caveat: These are vendor-curated demonstrations, not proof of reliable general-purpose autonomous simulation generation.

news.title: DNeo preprint revisits speculative drafter feature encoding
news.summary: A November 16 preprint proposes mixture-of-features attention, rejected-draft memory and layer-selection changes to improve parallel draft acceptance.
news.why_it_matters: Could improve throughput when GPU verification and drafter features are the bottleneck.
news.caveat: Authors report a 1.3× advantage over DFlash-2 in studied settings; results are not an independent universal throughput ranking.

news.title: RepoFactory evolves verifiable training environments for coding agents
news.summary: A November 16 preprint creates 10,159 repository-derived build-from-spec environments, optimizing validity and scope with an Environment Evolution Loop.
news.why_it_matters: Provides a possible way to scale training feedback for long-horizon coding tasks without repeatedly training an agent for every candidate environment.
news.caveat: Reported benchmark improvements are author-run and depend on the selected environment and baseline.

news.title: Multi-Branch Transformer explores parallel full-block branches
news.summary: A November 15 preprint evaluates shared initial/final transformer layers around parallel independently parameterized block branches in 0.8B–2.1B MoE training experiments.
news.why_it_matters: Investigates architecture scaling beyond simply increasing depth or width, with potential speed/quality tradeoffs.
news.caveat: Matched-budget results are author-reported, small relative to frontier LLMs and not a verified production replacement.

news.title: On-policy distillation study flags harmful cross-domain tool habits
news.summary: A November 14 preprint studies how on-policy distillation shifts ReAct tool use and reports negative transfer to τ²-bench from an ALFWorld-trained student.
news.why_it_matters: Warns that fine-tuning a small agent on one environment can silently transplant poor tool-use policies to another.
news.caveat: The authors' 41.5%-to-6.6% drop and partial mitigation are particular experimental conditions, not an inherent consequence of all distillation.

technologies.name: Gemini API Tool Retrieval
aliases: Deferred tool-schema loading in Interactions API
technologies.explanation: API mechanism for resolving selected function schemas at inference time from server-side or developer-side tool search.
technologies.conditional_advantage: Large registries with a low fraction of tools used per request can save input tokens and keep cached prefixes stable.
technologies.hardware_runtime_constraints: Gemini 3.6+ via hosted Interactions API; client search adds a network round-trip.
technologies.license_uncertainty: Proprietary hosted API feature; developer's own tools retain their separate licenses.
technologies.availability_uncertainty: Preview; compatible models and accounts may vary.
technologies.pricing_uncertainty: No separate feature fee, but normal tokens, loaded schemas and tool searches are billed.

technologies.name: Genie 4 via Gemini API
technologies.explanation: Google-hosted text/image-conditioned generation of navigable audiovisual environments with real-time text and keyboard edits.
technologies.conditional_advantage: Useful when interactive scene prototyping matters more than deterministic physical simulation.
technologies.hardware_runtime_constraints: Google AI Studio / Interactions API; GPU infrastructure operated by provider.
technologies.license_uncertainty: Proprietary API outputs and usage permissions need current service terms.
technologies.availability_uncertainty: Developer API announced 19 Nov; regional and plan access not independently audited.
technologies.pricing_uncertainty: Pricing linked by provider but exact per-session charges were not independently confirmed.

technologies.name: Olala mini 7A1B
technologies.explanation: Sparse ~7B-total/~1B-active mixture-of-experts LLM using a hybrid Differential-TPA and Mamba-3 attention architecture.
technologies.conditional_advantage: May fit low-memory inference or European-hosted deployments if official speed and quality claims hold on target hardware.
tradeoffs: Unknown supported context in tested build
technologies.hardware_runtime_constraints: OVH reports BF16, 8GB GPU operation or CPU use; benchmark figures for A4500 and unspecified CPU need reproduction.
technologies.license_uncertainty: Open model intent announced; exact checkpoint license and redistribution rights require artifact-level confirmation.
technologies.availability_uncertainty: First public announcement Nov 17, event launch Nov 19; artifact mirrors and production endpoint availability unverified.
technologies.pricing_uncertainty: Hosted and self-hosted cost unknown; hardware requirements vary by quantization and runtime.

technologies.name: OpenEval Commons item-level evaluation collection
technologies.explanation: Large item- and response-level benchmark dataset with per-benchmark tables enabling cross-model analysis.
technologies.conditional_advantage: Enables error-distribution and agreement analysis beyond simple model leaderboard averages.
technologies.hardware_runtime_constraints: Parquet on Hugging Face; multi-GB storage and query tooling (datasets/Dask/Polars) recommended.
technologies.license_uncertainty: Dataset card declares CC BY-NC 4.0; per-benchmark upstream rights may differ.
technologies.availability_uncertainty: Public dataset card Nov 19 update, subset completeness and freshness not independently checked.
technologies.pricing_uncertainty: Dataset accessible publicly; bandwidth/storage and hosting charges vary.

technologies.name: DNeo speculative parallel drafter
technologies.explanation: Research drafter that conditions parallel speculative token proposals on encoded target features and memory of rejected candidate tokens.
technologies.conditional_advantage: Can reduce effective per-output-token work when verifier parallelism and accurate draft acceptance dominate latency.
tradeoffs: Unproven speed outside evaluated batch sizes
technologies.hardware_runtime_constraints: Research uses H100 and Qwen3-4B settings; released code/weights linked from arXiv but compatibility must be verified.
technologies.license_uncertainty: Check linked code and weight licenses individually; preprint alone is not a usage license.
technologies.availability_uncertainty: Preprint and artifact links available; turnkey engine integration not established.
technologies.pricing_uncertainty: No commercial pricing; compute costs depend on model, GPU and batching.

technologies.name: RepoFactory environment evolution pipeline
technologies.explanation: Method to turn public repositories into verifiable build-from-description coding tasks and iteratively select environments via validity/complexity proxy objectives.
technologies.conditional_advantage: Potentially produces more informative long-horizon coding-agent training tasks than unguided synthetic repository examples.
tradeoffs: Need accurate test harnesses and sandbox isolation
technologies.hardware_runtime_constraints: Requires code execution sandboxes, storage for generated repos and model training compute for student agents.
technologies.license_uncertainty: Paper does not establish blanket rights to all harvested repositories or generated environments.
technologies.availability_uncertainty: Research-stage; repository-code and dataset availability require separate verification.
technologies.pricing_uncertainty: No service pricing; environment validation and training can be compute-intensive.

terms.name: Deferred tool-schema loading
terms.definition: An agent interface strategy that exposes a tool's existence without inserting its full argument specification into the initial prompt.
terms.mechanism: After search selects a candidate tool, its detailed parameter schema is loaded just in time for the model to call it.
terms.example: A support agent sees the name of a refund tool but loads its complete JSON parameters only if the user requests a refund.
terms.caveat: Tool discovery does not grant authorization; deferring a heavily used tool may add latency.

terms.name: Mixture-of-Features Attention
terms.definition: A DNeo research component that aggregates selected internal target-model features while maintaining information about previously rejected draft proposals.
terms.mechanism: The parallel drafter attends to selected target features and rejection history to improve multi-token proposal acceptance.
terms.example: A small drafter reuses a failed speculative proposal as contextual information before proposing its next token block.
terms.caveat: This is a paper-specific architecture, not a general benchmark-proven attention replacement.

terms.name: Environment Evolution Loop
terms.definition: A feedback-guided process for generating and refining verifiable training environments using proxy measures before expensive end-task agent training.
terms.mechanism: RepoFactory balances environment validity, structural coupling and implementation scope while selecting new repository tasks.
terms.example: An automated task generator rejects a trivial coding environment and evolves a more interconnected project with valid tests.
terms.caveat: Proxy quality can be gamed; useful environments still require external task validation.

terms.name: Transformer block branching
terms.definition: A model-architecture pattern that executes distinct sequences of Transformer blocks concurrently between shared input and output layers.
terms.mechanism: Each branch processes the same shared representation and a fusion stage combines their outputs before later shared blocks.
terms.example: A two-branch model uses shared embedding layers, two parallel block stacks and a final projection.
terms.caveat: Parallel computation needs hardware support; reported quality gains are limited to tested 0.8B–2.1B MoE scales.
